response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack developer with a strong track record across web, mobile, and embedded systems, and he does have some geospatial domain exposure via GISCollective. However, his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js and JavaScript ecosystems, with no evidence of modern C++ or Rust work in the past decade, and no experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance pipelines, or large-scale distributed systems of the kind described in the role.
strengths: Broad, adaptable engineering background spanning web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Direct experience building a geospatial/GIS platform (GISCollective) with real-world users
Demonstrated systems-level and low-latency programming experience (DLang, C/C++ at National Instruments and Sociomantic)
concerns: No recent (last 8+ years) hands-on C++ or Rust experience; last significant C++ work was 2014-2015
No experience with routing tile generation, navigation guidance systems, or traffic-data integration
Career trajectory has moved toward high-level web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js), diverging from the low-level systems focus required

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent C++/Rust systems experience
